_metadata.description: OT-P1-001 — thin guided completion + canonical structured handoff assembled from in-flow state.

requirements.title: Thin guided completion assembles the canonical handoff from captured state
requirements.description: A complete flow runs a thin guided completion process (nudges to record findings, file bugs, confirm phase status) and assembles the canonical handoff record from state captured in-flow during the run, with full/partial + resume point computed. plan-manager owns only the structured handoff; the prose final-message catch-all is captured by the orchestration layer.

validation.notes: Completion assembles canonical handoff from captured decisions, findings, validation, and phase state.

requirements.title: Findings are candidates pending operator triage; attribution prevents double-filing
requirements.description: Findings recorded during a run are filed as candidate (explicitly unvalidated) entries an operator triages before they become real bugs. The finalizer reconciles against run-id attribution (VROOLI_AGENT_MANAGER_RUN_ID) so anything the agent already did during the run is not double-filed.

validation.notes: Recorded findings are candidates and carry run attribution.
Attribution and normalized title prevent double-filing within the same run.
